landing.h1: The hospital Chattogram has been waiting for.
landing.sub: Neobee Hospital PLC is a shareholder-owned hospital company building a modern, multidisciplinary hospital in Chattogram — founded by ordinary people pooling an extraordinary commitment.
landing.heroAlt: Architectural render of the planned Neobee Hospital campus in Chattogram
landing.projectTitle: A full-service hospital, planned end to end.
landing.projectBody: Emergency and ICU care, diagnostics, maternity and specialist outpatient services — designed as one connected campus so patients don't have to leave the city for answers. Construction follows a phased plan: foundation first, then wards, then specialist centres.
landing.projectImgAlt: Concept render of the planned hospital entrance lobby
landing.pillar1Body: World-class treatment without a ticket to Bangkok or Dhaka. Chattogram's families deserve care where they live.
landing.pillar2Body: A hospital held by hundreds of shareholders, not a handful of investors — accountable to the community it serves.
landing.pillar3Body: Every deposit registered, every receipt verifiable, every decision documented. Trust is a system, not a slogan.
landing.pillar4Body: Phased construction, disciplined governance and reinvested surpluses — so the hospital outlives its founders.
landing.bandGloss: Commercial, yet humane — affordable care with a conscience.
landing.joinTitle: Ready to be part of it?
landing.joinBody: Leave your details and our team will guide you through every step — deposit registration is always done with a real person.
landing.glanceHint: A shareable summary of the project — facts only, no figures about fundraising. Nothing leaves your device.

about.h1: Started by ordinary people, for ordinary people.
about.headAlt: Planning blueprints and campus drawings for the hospital
about.originTitle: From a simple question to a company.
about.origin1: Neobee began with a simple question: why does serious healthcare in this city mean travelling somewhere else? The answer became a company — Neobee Hospital PLC — where the hospital is owned by the very people who will walk through its doors.
about.origin2: Commercial, yet humane — কমার্শিয়াল কিন্তু মানবিক। To serve the country and its people with whatever means Allah has granted us. Two sites have been shortlisted — at Panchlaish and beside Chattogram Medical College; site selection is near-final, In sha Allah.
about.origin3: The founding-entrepreneur idea is a partnership, not a scheme. The project will onboard 50 founding partners/entrepreneurs — entry ৳20,00,000, used for the registered bayna of the land. Every taka is receipted and every shareholder is on the register.
about.originAlt: Concept render of a private hospital ward
about.step1Body: Early supporters register first and set the tone.
about.step2Body: Founders stand with the board through the riskiest years.
about.step3Body: The early-phase incentive recognizes that early trust.
about.value1Text: We do what we said, in writing.

shareDetails.title: What a share includes
shareDetails.lead: One share is ৳2,00,000, paid in full at a discount or in four kistis. Every verified shareholder receives a digital money receipt, a unique ID, and portal access.
shareDetails.fullBody: A ৳2,00,000 share for ৳1,90,000 — you save ৳{discount} per share by paying in full at once.
shareDetails.kistiBody: Pay ৳50,000 every 6 months over 4 kistis. Deadlines: 1st by 31 Aug 2026, 2nd by 31 Dec 2026, 3rd by 30 Jun 2027, final by 31 Dec 2027.
shareDetails.kistiOneShareNote: Kisti payment is currently available for exactly 1 share.
shareDetails.benefitsNote: Facilities apply at Neobee Hospital & Diagnostic Centre. Share value can also be used to pay hospital bills — your share works like future health insurance for the family.
shareDetails.familyBody: Facilities extend to the shareholder's family:
shareDetails.familyMax: Up to 6 beneficiaries per share and unique ID.
shareDetails.doc4: Investment certificate / deed (issued on full payment)
shareDetails.bankBody: Deposits are received only in the official Neobee Hospital account:
shareDetails.refundBody: To withdraw, apply to the finance officer. Refunds are processed within 7 working days, less a 10% service charge.
